sources.substantiates: Date, start time, event number, official event name and structure-sheet URL for all 94 published starts (events 1-64).

sources.label: DeepStack Extravaganza IV official schedule PDF (late-registration close times, chips, level minutes)
sources.substantiates: REG CLOSES time, CHIPS and LEVEL minutes for each start. Verbatim copy retained at raw/venetian_dse_nov_2026_schedule.md.

sources.label: DSE IV structure sheets 1-37 (official PDFs)
sources.substantiates: Buy-in, house fee (rake + staff), prize-pool share, guarantee, starting chips, level duration, late-registration, bounty rules, multi-flight rules, age restrictions and payout percentage for every event. All 37 sheets were read in full; each row links its own sheet.

sources.label: Poker room page (location, hours, room size, current/next series)
sources.substantiates: Poker room is in The Palazzo, level 2, Grand Canal Shoppes; open 24 hours daily; 50 tables over 14,000 sq ft.

sources.label: Resort Fee page
sources.substantiates: Daily resort fee of $55 plus tax per night, payable on check-in, and what it includes.

sources.label: 2026 poker suite rate information guide
sources.substantiates: Poker rates 'start as low as $119 and $209'; $55 resort fee per night; qualifying play is six hours of live cash game OR a buy-in to a $300+ tournament per night; code EPOKR25; rates only published out to 150 days.

sources.label: Hotel terms and conditions (taxes, fees, parking, cancellation)
sources.substantiates: Clark County Room Tax of 13.38% excluded from daily rates; $55 resort fee; self-parking $20/day for registered guests, valet $40/day; check-in 3:00 pm, check-out 11:00 am; early departure fee $100 plus tax; incidental deposit $150 per night.

sources.label: Poker room self-parking information
sources.substantiates: Poker players who play three hours or more in tournament or cash games receive complimentary self-parking for the day (supervisor must confirm the session).
